lixpiValue: veoParams.video, set at google-provider.ts:844 for a video-extension request
summary: Extends a Veo-generated source clip by roughly seven seconds and returns one combined video. It is a continuation mode, not arbitrary video-to-video editing, and Veo 3.1 Lite does not support it.
combines: Supported on Veo 3.1 and Veo 3.1 Fast through the Gemini Developer API; Veo 3.1 Lite does not support extension.
Gemini API accepts only videos that Veo generated, typically passed straight from `operation.response.generatedVideos[0].video`.
The source video must have been generated or referenced within the last 2 days; referencing it for extension resets its 2-day timer.
range: Gemini API: Veo-generated videos only, up to 141 seconds long, 720p, 9:16 or 16:9. Vertex's newer extension guide states input videos of 1 to 30 seconds and output up to 37 seconds for Veo.

usage.from: state.videoSourceForExtension, resolved to bytes from an authorized stored Asset
usage.what: Loads the selected source Asset, sends it through source.video, suppresses frame inputs, and applies Veo's 720p and eight-second extension constraints.
